scientific_target.reference_work: Grant et al., Addressing Divergent Representations from Causal Interventions on Neural Networks, ICLR 2026 Oral
scientific_target.inherited_premise: causal interventions can create divergent internal representations
scientific_target.green_advance: prospectively identify behaviorally successful but non-transporting or mechanism-misaligned interventions and validate the warning independently

candidate_population.temporal_eligibility: every structural readout head must be strictly downstream of the patch
candidate_population.candidate_rule: immutable deterministic prompt/site universe; no selection using GREEN, baseline, transport, or NMH outcomes

primary_endpoint.name: sealed_heldout_causal_transport_failure
primary_endpoint.continuous_measure: normalized response RMSE between target and patched computations on the sealed endpoint direction panel
primary_endpoint.failure_label: split-conformal exceedance relative to an endpoint-only target-target replay calibration distribution

secondary_endpoint.name: IOI_downstream_Name_Mover_Head_recovery
secondary_endpoint.role: task-specific structural validation; never used to construct the GREEN certificate or primary transport label

replication_requirement.rule: unchanged GREEN decision rule on at least one different task or model/mechanism family
replication_requirement.candidate: Greater-Than or a second pretrained-model IOI implementation

execution_barrier: No real outcome may run until record universe, split, direction payloads, endpoint calibration, baseline implementations, analysis code, and artifact hashes are frozen and independently audited.
